node.title: Re^2: How come @_ gets changed here?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Interesting, a bisect with a test program something like this:

my @a=(3); sub x { @a = map {$_*2} @_; "@_" eq "6" or die } &x(@a);

says that the first bad commit is [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/a5f48505593c7e1ca478de383e24d5cc2541f3ca|a5f4850559], which makes v5.24.0, or more specifically v5.23.2, the first version with this behavior. Since that commit is heavy on the internals and I'm not an expert on that, I can't say more at the moment, although it does seem like a regression to me.
